Origin: East Blue Civilian

background_world_feed:
February 1, 1522 — Luffy leaves Foosha Village
Location: Foosha Village. Seventeen-year-old Monkey D. Luffy sets out alone to become King of the Pirates, beginning the East Blue voyage. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

February 3, 1522 — Shells Town upheaval
Location: Shells Town. Roronoa Zoro is freed and Captain Morgan and his son Helmeppo are overthrown, ending the base's corrupt rule; Zoro joins Luffy. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

February 6, 1522 — Orange Town crisis
Location: Orange Town. Buggy the Clown's pirates are defeated; Nami temporarily allies with the crew. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

February 11, 1522 — Syrup Village conspiracy
Location: Syrup Village. Captain Kuro's plot against Kaya is exposed and defeated. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

Location: Syrup Village. Kaya, newly free of Kuro's manipulation, gives Usopp and the crew the ship that becomes the Going Merry; Usopp joins. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

February 14, 1522 — Baratie conflict
Location: Baratie. Don Krieg's armada is repelled at the floating restaurant; Sanji joins the crew and Dracule Mihawk marks Zoro as a rival worth surviving for. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.
